title: Servicing Academy Notes: Late-Fee Courtesy for a Light Recent Record
content:
**Rule.** A late fee on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts is multiplied by a courtesy multiplier set by the contract's recent record. A late fee already on the loan history counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its assessment date from the new assessment date; a returned payment counts when fewer than 6 whole months separate the date of the return from the new assessment date.

| Late fees counted (12-month window) | Returned payments counted (6-month window) | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| at most one | none | clean-record late-fee courtesy: the capped late fee is multiplied by 0.5 before rounding |
| at most one | at least one | returned-payment late-fee courtesy: the capped late fee is multiplied by 0.6 before rounding |
| two or more | any | no courtesy; the fee is charged in full |

## Questions answered

**What does the multiplier act on?** The late fee after it has been capped at the tier's maximum late fee, and before it is rounded to the cent.

**How are whole months counted?** From the date of the earlier entry to the new assessment date, a month is whole once the same day of the month is reached. A late fee assessed on 2025-08-16 is 11 whole months before an assessment on 2026-08-15 and counts; against an assessment on 2026-08-16 it is 12 whole months before and does not count.

**And the 6-month window?** A return dated 2026-02-20 is 5 whole months before an assessment on 2026-08-19 and counts; against 2026-08-20 it is 6 whole months before and does not count.

**Does a record with no late fee at all qualify?** Yes: "at most one" includes none.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Capped late fee 24.00, one earlier late fee in the 12-month window, no return in the 6-month window: 24.00 multiplied by 0.5 is 12.00.
- Capped late fee 24.00, no earlier late fee, one return in the 6-month window: 24.00 multiplied by 0.6 is 14.40.
- Capped late fee 24.00, two earlier late fees in the 12-month window: charged in full, 24.00.
